'''Xesh's Forcesaber''' was the personal [[Forcesaber]] of the [[Force Hound]], [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]]. It was purple bladed and Xesh used it while in service to his [[Predor]] master [[Tul'kar]]. This weapon was present when Xesh traveled to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and he used it to break the [[Madog steel]] blades of [[Sek'nos Rath]] and [[Hawk Ryo]] in his [[Duel at the Rift|duel]] between the three [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s that encountered him. This Forcesaber was later confiscated by the [[Je'daii Order]], and [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Hawk Ryo]] was given the blade to use as his own.
